solutions.title: Backtracking counts
solutions.strategy: Grow valid prefixes by tracking how many opening and closing parentheses have been used.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are C_n valid strings and each output string has length 2n.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The result stores every string; the recursion path uses O(n).

solutions.title: Catalan DP composition
solutions.strategy: Build every size by wrapping a left subproblem and appending a right subproblem.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every valid output is produced and copied; duplicate-free composition still emits C_n strings.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The DP table and final output store generated strings.
